### A Song for the Snow
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-feb-3-2010-11625772.html
Passage: Psalm 40:1, 3
Points:
- Unplanned delays and disruptions test our patience and expose our desire for control.
- Forced pauses provide an opportunity to slow down and see God's hand at work.
- God's grace and protective purpose often become clearest in hindsight.
- True joy arises when we allow God to replace our self-centered plans with a new song of praise.

### None Can Compare with God
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/none-can-compare-with-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 40:4-5
Points:
- Worldly comforts and mental distractions offer hollow substitutes that fail to provide real peace.
- Genuine biblical trust demands an active surrender of control rather than reliance on human pride.
- Earthly idols and self-sufficiency inevitably lead to disappointment and emptiness.
- Meditating on God's countless wonders and sovereign plans replaces anxiety with awe and worship.

### A New Song
Author: Mark Ross
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/new-song
Passage: Psalm 40:1-17
Points:
- Deliverance from severe trouble naturally calls forth praise and thanksgiving to God.
- Believers still encounter recurring trials, external opposition, and grief over personal sins.
- Rehearsing God's past mercies through song establishes a firm foundation to endure present suffering.
- The testimony of God lifting the lowly gives hope and encouragement to the entire community of faith.
